# TechVerge Solutions

> Custom AI automation and voice agents for small businesses.

TechVerge Solutions designs and implements custom AI lead follow-up, inbound voice agents, business process automation, and client-owned AI software. We primarily serve small and service businesses in the United States, and also work with clients in the United Kingdom and the United Arab Emirates.

## Services

- [AI Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/ai-automation): Custom workflows that reply to new enquiries quickly, qualify interest, and route ready leads to your team.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/ai-voice-agents): Custom inbound voice agents that answer routine calls, qualify callers, and help schedule with clear human handoffs.
- [Business Process Automation](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/business-automation): Automations across forms, CRM, email, calendars, and internal tools so teams spend less time on repetitive admin.
- [AI SaaS & Custom Software](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services/ai-saas-development): Custom AI-powered applications and internal tools built around your workflows—software you own, not seats on a TechVerge product.
- [All services](https://www.techvergesolution.com/services): Overview of what we design and implement.
